title: Base Magica (Stand Here)
summary: A bare plinth that confers arthood on whoever stands on it, and withdraws it the moment they step off.
mechanism: The CSS :has() relational selector styles the parent gallery by its contents (hover/focus/checked), so the container recognising an occupant is itself the act of nomination — zero JavaScript.
references: Piero Manzoni, Base Magica — Scultura Vivente (1961)
Brian O'Doherty, Inside the White Cube (1976)
CSS Selectors Level 4, the :has() relational pseudo-class
